metadata.description: Curated debt/leverage research data for DAT companies
metadata.sources: Strategy.com/debt (live), SEC EDGAR filings, company IR pages, training knowledge (pre-2025 filings)
metadata.disclaimer: Debt data may be stale. Verify against latest SEC filings before making decisions.

MSTR.US.name: Strategy (MicroStrategy)
MSTR.US.lockReason: BTC held in custody, no staking/lock constraints
MSTR.US.mnavSource: Estimated based on historical MSTR premium patterns
MSTR.US.notes: Largest corporate BTC holder. Convertible notes are equity-settled (no forced BTC liquidation), but bankruptcy still possible if stock crashes and refinancing fails.

XXI.US.name: Twenty One Capital

debt.source: New entity (2025 SPAC merger via Cantor Equity Partners). Limited public debt disclosures.

XXI.US.lockReason: Funded via SPAC equity + Tether/Bitfinex contributions
XXI.US.notes: Backed by Tether, SoftBank, Bitfinex. Primarily equity-funded. Launched with ~31,500 BTC at inception.

3350.T.name: Metaplanet

debt.source: Metaplanet IR press releases, JPY bonds converted at ~150 JPY/USD. Data estimated from multiple issuances.

3350.T.mnavSource: Estimated; known to trade at significant premium on Tokyo exchange
3350.T.notes: Japanese listed company. Issued multiple zero-coupon bonds to buy BTC. High mNAV premium. Aggressive accumulation strategy.

MARA.US.name: MARA Holdings (Marathon Digital)

debt.source: MARA SEC filings (8-K, 2024). Approximate values from public issuance announcements.

MARA.US.lockReason: Combination of mined and purchased BTC; no staking constraints disclosed
MARA.US.mnavSource: Estimated; MARA historically trades closer to NAV than MSTR
MARA.US.notes: BTC miner + treasury company. Revenue from mining operations partially offsets debt service.

RIOT.US.name: Riot Platforms
RIOT.US.lockReason: BTC held in custody, not staked
RIOT.US.notes: BTC miner with HODL strategy. Has mining revenue stream. Relatively conservative leverage.

CLSK.US.name: CleanSpark
CLSK.US.notes: BTC miner. Revenue from mining operations. Moderate leverage.

SMLR.US.name: Semler Scientific

debt.source: Semler Scientific press releases and 8-K filings 2024. Data estimated.

SMLR.US.mnavSource: Estimated; medical device company pivoting to BTC treasury
SMLR.US.notes: Medical device company that adopted BTC treasury strategy in 2024. Small position relative to other DAT companies.

BMNR.US.name: BitMine Immersion
BMNR.US.lockReason: Large ETH position (5.7M ETH) likely includes staked ETH with withdrawal queue constraints
BMNR.US.notes: Extremely large reported ETH position (4.8% of circulating supply) - data may include custodied/client assets. Verify independently.

SBET.US.name: SharpLink Gaming

debt.source: Limited public disclosures. Pivoted to ETH treasury strategy 2024.

SBET.US.lockReason: ETH may be partially staked for yield generation
SBET.US.notes: Gaming/sports betting company that pivoted to ETH treasury. Micro-cap.

BTBT.US.name: Bit Digital

debt.source: Bit Digital 10-K filings. Primarily equity funded.

BTBT.US.lockReason: ETH staking operations - ETH is staked for validator rewards, subject to withdrawal queue
BTBT.US.notes: Crypto miner + ETH staker. Revenue from staking + GPU computing. No significant debt.

DFDV.US.name: DeFi Development Corp

debt.source: Newly renamed/restructured company. Limited historical filings.

DFDV.US.lockReason: SOL likely staked for validator rewards; unstaking takes ~2 days on Solana
DFDV.US.notes: Formerly Janover. Pivoted to SOL treasury + staking strategy in early 2025.

UPXI.US.name: Upexi

debt.source: Upexi press releases. Funded via equity raise ($100M+).

UPXI.US.lockReason: SOL staked for yield; Solana unstaking period ~2-3 days
UPXI.US.mnavSource: Estimated; known to trade at premium post-pivot announcement
UPXI.US.notes: Consumer products company that pivoted to SOL treasury. Funded by equity raise. High mNAV premium.

HODL.CN.name: SOL Strategies

debt.source: SOL Strategies press releases. CAD-denominated, converted at ~0.73 USD/CAD.

HODL.CN.lockReason: Operates SOL validators; staked SOL subject to unstaking period
HODL.CN.notes: Canadian-listed SOL treasury + validator operator. Previously named Cypherpunk Holdings.

GLXY.US.name: Galaxy Digital

debt.source: Galaxy Digital financial reports. Diversified digital asset firm with trading desk.

GLXY.US.mnavSource: Estimated; recently migrated listing from TSX to NASDAQ
GLXY.US.notes: Diversified crypto firm (trading, lending, mining, investments). Multi-asset holdings. Not a pure treasury play.

COIN.US.name: Coinbase Global

debt.source: Coinbase 10-K 2024. Large exchange with diversified revenue.

COIN.US.lockReason: Exchange operator; crypto on balance sheet is corporate treasury, highly liquid
COIN.US.mnavSource: Not applicable - Coinbase is valued as an exchange, not a treasury vehicle
COIN.US.notes: Largest US crypto exchange. Holdings are corporate treasury, not primary business model. $4.3B debt offset by substantial revenue ($5B+ annual).
